name: arith_abundant_mul
informal: Every positive multiple of an abundant number is abundant — Uses Mathlib2.ab_abundant_def at the first and last step to pass to full divisor sums, and Mathlib2.ab_t2_mul_mem_divisors to inject d ↦ k·d from divisors of n into divisors of k·n, so σ(kn) ≥ kσ(n) > 2kn.
